messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — embedding/reranker pipeline error spike detected. Error rate > 15% for batch-embed endpoint in us-west-2. Ticket created: INC-2026-847. Please acknowledge.
oncall-arlene: Acked. I'm on it. Starting triage now. Any customer-facing alerts yet?
sre-sudhir: I'm watching logs. Looks like a burst of `vector_length_mismatch` from the batch inference worker. Spikes started ~1771239400.
eng-maria: Not seeing deploys in the last 6 hours. No config rollouts either. @sre-sudhir can you paste a sample error line?
sre-sudhir: Sure — from worker-07 (us-west-2):
```
ERROR 2026-02-10T07:56:12Z batch_infer.go:214 payload_size=2048 expected_vec_len=1536 got_vec_len=2048 request_id=ck_1A2B3
CAUSE: downstream-reranker rejected vector, returning 422
```
ml-jess: That `expected_vec_len=1536` is suspicious — we recently updated quantization profile to 1536 tokens on small-embed model. But request vectors are 2048.
ops-lin: Where are the vectors coming from? The batch endpoint transforms upstream indexer outputs before sending to reranker.
eng-maria: I pulled the batch request from s3 (s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1771239999/sample-batch.json) — the embedder output shows 2048 dims for about ~12% of items.
customer-support-jenna: FYI: Two customers reported increased 500s in the last 10 min (CS-2456, CS-2457). Both are using the batch-embed pipeline.
product-tyler: Can we scope impact: number of affected requests, and are retries causing downstream queue growth?
sre-sudhir: Quick numbers: between 1771239360 and 1771239960 — ~14k batch items, ~1680 had 2048 vectors. Error rate ~12%. Backpressure observed on reranker queue (latency > 10s).
oncall-arlene: Hypothesis 1: Upstream embedder started emitting 2048-length vectors due to a model change or fallback. Hypothesis 2: Reranker expected 1536 and rejected. Need to confirm model versions.
eng-maria: Checking model manifest service: embedder model pinned to `embed-small@v2.1.4` — no recent deploy. But `embed-small` has multiple quantization paths; could be a fallback to full precision producing 2048 dims? That doesn't usually change vector length.
ml-jess: Vector dimensionality change usually comes from switching model architecture (e.g., 1536->2048). Have we onboarded any new model variants? Querying model-catalog.
infra-bot: deploybot: No deploys to embedder clusters in the last 24h. (checked tags: embedder/us-west-2)
eng-maria: I grabbed the binary artifact list from the nodes: worker-07 and worker-08 show `embed-runtime:2.1.4` but with env var `EMBED_MODE=experimental_dual` on worker-07 only.
ops-lin: That env var might flip to a different model variant. Who changed node config? Maybe a bad autoscaling bootstrap script.
oncall-arlene: Action: scale down worker-07 (isolated) and redirect new batch traffic away from it. I'll trigger cordon.
eng-maria: Command run:
```
rb node cordon worker-07 --reason="investigate-vectorlen"
rb router set-weight batch-embed us-west-2 worker-07 0
```
sre-sudhir: After cordon, error rate dropped to 2% in the next 3 minutes. Looks like worker-07 was the main source.
ml-jess: Great. That supports the single-node misconfig hypothesis. Now need to find cause: why env var present on only that node.
ops-lin: Investigating bootstrap logs for worker-07: found a race in autoscale init where bake script wrote `/etc/embedder/config` from a golden image that accidentally had `experimental_dual` set. Repro: yes.
product-tyler: Customer impact summary for ops: ~12% items failed for some batches sent during the window. Some retries succeeded, but others returned 422 to clients — potential partial data loss for index jobs.
customer-support-jenna: I'm drafting a status update to affected customers: short note + ETA for RCA. Will post once we have confirmed root cause.
sre-sudhir: For the in-incident RCA thread — I'll assemble timeline markers:
- 1771239360: first vector_length_mismatch logged
- 1771239403: incident-bot alerted (error rate > 10%)
- 1771239440: oncall-arlene acknowledged
- 1771239488: worker-07 cordoned & traffic drained
- 1771239560: errors dropped to baseline
- 1771240200: confirmed env var mismatch on worker-07
- 1771241200: hotfix: rollout to remove experimental flag from bootstrap image

eng-maria: Adding logs chunk (sanitized):
```
--- worker-07 init ---
INFO 1771239001 bake.sh: applied config from image: /images/embedder-golden-2026-02-09
WARN 1771239003 env-loader: found EMBED_MODE=experimental_dual
INFO 1771239004 runtime: started with model=embed-small-dual dims=2048
```
ml-jess: That runtime line is the smoking gun — experimental_dual yields 2048 dims.
ops-lin: Root cause hypothesized: golden image used for new node pool included experimental flag accidentally. Autoscale launched a node with that image => inconsistent vector dims.
oncall-arlene: Mitigations performed in flight:
- cordoned worker-07 and drained traffic
- blocked autoscaler from using the golden image (temp revert)
- rolled a config patch to ensure `EMBED_MODE` defaults to `stable` on startup
- customer notice drafted

eng-maria: Post-incident tasks to track in the RCA:
- [P0] Rebuild golden image without experimental flag, add CI check to assert no experimental envs (owner: ops-lin)
- [P1] Add runtime validation at batch-ingest: verify vector dims vs expected and auto-convert or route to a fallback transformer (owner: eng-maria)
- [P1] Improve telemetry: emit node-provisioning metadata to runtime logs (owner: infra-team)
- [P2] Update runbooks: add `vector-length-mismatch` triage steps and automation to drain bad nodes (owner: sre-sudhir)

ml-jess: One more note: add a model-catalog invariant check during routing — if vector dims mismatch model manifest, route to transformer that can pad/truncate before reranker.
product-tyler: Also evaluate customer-facing compensation (retry credits) for affected ingest batches. We'll loop legal.
customer-support-jenna: Posting initial status to customers now. Copying in support playbook. :email:
eng-maria: For the postmortem doc, I'll include logs, timeline, who touched what, and a small sandbox repro. Anyone want to add hypotheses we didn't cover?
sre-sudhir: Hypothesis: unrelated network corruption altering payload size — low confidence, deprioritized. We can close once golden image fix is validated.
ops-lin: Will open infra PR referencing INC-2026-847 and assign to image owners. Also adding a pre-merge smoke test to boot a node and validate `runtime: started with model` line.
oncall-arlene: Handoff: I'm on-call for another 30m, then @sre-sudhir will take over for the RCA writeup.
eng-maria: Leaving this thread with final notes: cordon removed only after patch verified; no other nodes showed `experimental_dual`. Closing incident as mitigated at 1771240100. Will publish postmortem draft in #postmortems within 24h.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-847 status -> mitigated. Auto-closing pager. :white_check_mark:
